root_cause: Original autonomous-email composer rejects actions without source-specific evidence; source research can complete into canonical company-news and its original research action, but original composer never reads that completion before source preflight. Schedulers report internal success while provider-accepted email remains zero.

observed_evidence.gmail_preflight: ok account/user resolved; no send implied

fix: Read original research_enrichment by its dedupe ID, then cross-check canonical company-news identity, timestamps, confidence and exact HTTPS source in existing composer. Re-run original quality gate. Preserve distinct recipient authority, suppression, idempotence, provider ACK/readback and outcome gates.
prevention_rule: No research action marked done, cron succeeded, positive model score or draft created is accepted as provider delivery. Research completeness requires verified source-to-original-action writeback; send requires provider acceptance/readback; causal learning requires valid sample/outcome design.
terminal_rule: Required and CodeQL green, protected merge, deployed original Supabase composer, original blocked action re-evaluated against current company evidence, approved quality if eligible, then independent provider-ID/readback for any sent email; no forced send if source remains missing. Never mark GREEN with internal cron receipt alone.
